sponsorOptOut.title: Leave your company membership programme
sponsorOptOut.explanation: Confirm that you want to leave your company’s membership programme. This ends your current and future seats from this company. Nothing else about your account changes. A later list from the company is a new agreement.
sponsorOptOut.done: You have left the programme. A confirmation e-mail follows.
sponsorOptOut.invalid: This link is no longer valid.
sponsorOptOut.error: We could not confirm your request. Please try again.
